card.name: Digits inside dates, times, section numbers
card.fires_on: The second digit of a multi-digit number that is part of a date, clock time or section reference number such as 5.12 or 21:12. Also a month abbreviation in a date format string.

modes.label: Section reference digits
modes.description: Last digit of a numbered label cited in parentheses in drug label text.
modes.example: delayed-release capsules are not recommended in pediatric patients less than 2 years of age. ( 5.1<<2>> , 8.4 ) 5

modes.label: Dates and times
modes.description: A digit inside a date or clock time, such as the hour or month.

modes.label: Date format codes
modes.description: The month code letter in a date format string.

card.plain: It lights up on the middle of a number in a date, a time, or a section citation like 5.12.
